references.observations: Aerial view above the deck shows the paired arches, distinct red cycle strips and overhead lateral braces.
Oblique view shows the city-side river pier, thin cycle decks, approach tower and quay below.
Wide aerial view shows the full river arch, south transition stairs and the tower pair at the northern viaduct.
The national heritage register establishes the 50 / 120 / 50 m girder arrangement, 17.5 m rib rise, 23.2 m overall deck width, overhead K bracing and dressed granite pier and stair details.
